description: PROPOSAL ONLY — define a same-run managed capture manifest candidate that binds the reviewed #1461 hook/exec trace hashes without claiming strong attestation.
trust_notes: A repository validator may prove that a manifest is internally consistent with the reviewed #1461 correlation artifact, but it cannot prove that requirements.toml was the live effective managed layer.
A SHA-256 claim for managed policy or recorder bytes is a content-binding claim only until an independent administrator-controlled verifier proves the live bytes/source.
allow_managed_hooks_only_claimed=true is not equivalent to allow_managed_hooks_only being enforced at runtime.
No repository command creates the managed capture manifest; the future manifest must originate from an independently administered capture root.
Strong promotion requires an independently verified issuer/signature or equivalent administrator-controlled runtime provenance in a separately reviewed slice.
